ABOUT APOLLON STEEL INC
 Do you own a business where different pipes, fittings, coils, sheets, flanges etc are required? Are you looking for a reputed and reliable supplier from whom you can easily buy wide array of products? If the answer is yes, then your search ends here as 
Apollon steel INC
 is best for you. Apollon Steel INC is the best and leading metal supplier in India that not only manufactures, but also exports wide array of metal products all over the world. We offer premium quality of raw material to demanding international and national market. We are a well established and sizeable company that has been working since 45 years in the market. 
Apollon steel INC
 has been serving customers in different industries including precision engineering, shipbuilding, paper, power plants, fertilizer, defense etc. Wen offer the best quality of product to customers as per their demand and request at reasonable price. There are several products that we offer such as seamless pipes in carbon steel, alloy steel, stainless steel etc with the size of ½ NB to 32 NB, plates, sheets and coils with mild steel, hardox, nickel alloys and alloy steel metal. We also offer bars in different forms and shapes made with carbon steel, alloy steel, stainless steel and nickel alloy with the size of 5mm to 2000mm in diameter. 
All these products are well tested and inspected with IBR test, TUV, DNV and third-party inspection. All the items and products are manufactured as per national and international specification and standards. 
Apollon steel INC
 is one of the reputable industries that offer the best quality of metal products manufactured under the supervision of quality experts and using advanced technology. 
Our seamless operations enable us to offer a wide array of the products including,
SEAMLESS PIPES :
 CARBON STEEL / STAINLESS STEEL/ ALLOY STEEL/NICKLE ALLOYS ETC SIZE: ½”NB TO 32”NB in Schedule 10 to XXS
ERW/SAW/SPRIAL/WELDED PIPE :
 CARBON STEEL / STAINLESS STEEL/ ALLOYSTEEL/NICKLE ALLOYS ETC SIZE: ½”NB TO 32”NB in 2 mm to 100 mm Thk
PLATE/SHEET/COILS :
 STAINLESS STEEL / ALLOY STEEL – Crome Moly / NICKEL & NICKEL ALLOYS/ MILD STEEL/ BOILER QUALITY / CORTON/ HARDOX/ DILLIDUR 400V /  SAILMA/ SHIP BUILDING ETC
ROUND BAR/ SHAFT/ HOLLOW BARS :
 CARBON STEEL / STAINLESS STEEL/ ALLOY STEEL/NICKLE ALLOYS ETC SIZE: 5 MM TO 2000 MM DIA
LONG RADIUS BENDS :
 CARBON STEEL / STAINLESS STEEL/ ALLOY STEEL/NICKLE ALLOYS ETC SIZE : ½”NB TO 32”NB in 2 mm to 50 mm Thk RADIUS 2.5 D / 3 D / 5D / 10 D UPTO 22D FOR PIGLAUNCHING  STEAM & GENERAL PURPOSE FITTINGS.
ALL MATERIAL AVAILABLE WITH IBR TEST CERTIFICATE / THIRD PARTY INSPECTION EXCISE GATE PASS AVAILABLE
 We are approved suppliers to various government department & Public sectors all over the country & regularly supplying to them for a long time. We have got ready stock of the above items in various sizes as per National / International Standards & Specification & the same shall be supplied as per your requirements at very reasonable rates. We can arrange any Third Party inspection agency like LRIS, BVIS, IBR, TUV, DNV, MECON, MDL etc. 
As we are very much interested to do business with you on a long term basis, we request you to please enlist our name in your approved vendor list and send us your valued purchase enquiries from time to time so as to enable us to quote our most competitive rates and terms.
